acceptanceCriteria: A documented A/B walk-cost procedure records medians, load before/after and the command
It reports I/O wait separately from decode CPU
Linked from the Tasks performance docs
body: Friction from the pool-checkpoint lane (2026-10-21, branch claude/batch-pool-checkpoint, V1-1701 and V1-0895). Observed: after decode-only reuse cut the walk from 22.8 s to 14.3 s, the macOS profiler still attributed 66% to Syscall6/openat, but the walk was CPU-bound (repeated afterimage parsing). Expected: a diagnosis tool that separates I/O wait from CPU on the walking goroutine. The opt-in TestV11701_WalkCost harness exists; promote it to a documented A/B procedure with load capture.
title: Wall-clock A/B harness for Tasks journal walk cost; the macOS CPU profiler blames Syscall6/openat for CPU work
